q.instruction: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
q.passage:
Look at these two sentences.

(A) We say Bell invented the telephone because we are talking about Bell, and the new information is that he invented the telephone. When the subject is the person or thing doing the action (the agent), then we use an active verb. ACTIVE We say The telephone was invented by Bell because we are talking about the telephone, and the new information is that it was invented by Bell. When the subject is not the agent (is not doing the action), then we use a passive verb.

(B) One sentence is about Bell, and the other is about the telephone. Each sentence begins with the subject. The subject is the startingpoint of the sentence, the thing we are talking about. The new information about the subject comes at the end of the sentence.

(C) ACTIVE Bell invented the telephone. PASSIVE The telephone was invented by Bell. The two sentences have the same meaning, but they are about different things.
q.explanation:
원문 전개 순서는 (C) - (B) - (A)이다. 각 단락의 지시어·연결어가 앞 내용을 받아 이 순서로만 논리가 이어진다.
【출제의도】 응집 장치(지시어·연결어·정관사)로 글의 논리 순서를 재구성하는 능력을 평가한다.

q.instruction: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
q.passage:
[주어진 문장] Some chapters explore the socio-historical background of the period while others provide informa­ tion on prescriptivism, newspaper language, language contact and regional variation in British and American English.

Late Modern English Syntax The Late Modern period is the first in the history of English for which an unprece­ dented wealth of textual material exists. ( ① ) Using increasingly sophisticated databases, the contributions in this volume explore grammatical usage from the period, spe­ cifically morphological and syntactic change, in a broad context. ( ② ) Internal processes of change are discussed against grammaticalisation theory and construction grammar and the rich body of textual evidence is used to draw inferences on the precise nature of historical change. ( ③ ) Exposing readers to a wealth of data that informs the description of a broad range of syntactic phenomena, this book is ideal for graduate students and researchers interested in historical linguistics, corpus linguistics and language development. ( ④ ) Marianne Hundt is Full Professor of English Linguistics in the English Department at the University of Zurich, Switzerland. ( ⑤ )
q.explanation:
주어진 문장의 연결 단서가 ② 앞뒤 문장과만 자연스럽게 이어진다(원문 위치).
【출제의도】 주어진 문장의 지시어·연결어 단서로 흐름이 끊긴 위치를 찾는 능력을 평가한다.
